summary.business_type: Local Service — luxury wedding & event floral design studio (service-area model), Hudson NY; secondary Agency/portfolio profile
top_findings: Custom domain whimsyflower.com has no DNS; site lives only on a vercel.app subdomain
Zero geographic signal on the live site (fixed in working tree: titles, H1s, intros, footer, bio)
NAP conflict: The Knot / WeddingWire / whimsyflower.love list the studio in Hoboken–Jersey City NJ with phone 551-264-4181 and 'from $3,000'; new site says Hudson NY
Six /brands/{slug} pages expose fictional brands, stock photos and Lorem ipsum, and are orphaned
No robots.txt, sitemap.xml, canonical, Open Graph, or JSON-LD anywhere
quick_wins: Deploy the location copy changes already made (12 files, build verified)
Add app/robots.ts and app/sitemap.ts (code drafted in findings/sitemap.md)
Add the Florist/LocalBusiness + WebSite + Person + Service JSON-LD graph (findings/schema.md)
Fix href="" social icons (Instagram @whimsy_flower, TikTok @whimsyflower) and the href="#" Brides logo
Add Inquire CTA to the mobile header; eager-load first gallery photo to cut homepage mobile LCP from 4.4s

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Clean kebab-case URLs, single-hop trailing-slash redirects
100% image alt coverage; semantic HTML scored 100/100

findings.title: No DNS for whimsyflower.com
findings.description: dig returns no A/CNAME/NS records; only whimsy-flower.vercel.app resolves.
findings.recommendation: Add the domain in Vercel as production, redirect vercel.app, set metadataBase and canonical.

findings.title: robots.txt and sitemap.xml return 404
findings.description: sitemap_discovery.py found no declared or fallback sitemaps.
findings.recommendation: Add app/robots.ts and app/sitemap.ts importing galleries; exclude placeholder brand pages; submit in GSC.

findings.title: No canonical tags on any page
findings.description: No <link rel=canonical> on any of 8+ templates checked.
findings.recommendation: Set metadataBase and alternates.canonical in layout.tsx.

findings.title: 8 URLs inherited the homepage title/description
findings.description: /about, /inquire and six /brands/{slug} pages had no page-level metadata.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in working tree via page metadata and generateMetadata.

findings.title: No Open Graph / Twitter Card tags
findings.description: Link previews render blank for a visual brand.
findings.recommendation: Add openGraph and twitter metadata with a 1200x630 credited photo.

findings.title: Footer omits /brands
findings.description: Footer links: Home, Weddings, Events, About, Inquire only.
findings.recommendation: Add Editorial & Brands to the footer list.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: Only HSTS present; no CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy; ACAO * on HTML.
findings.recommendation: Add headers() in next.config.ts.

findings.title: Dead links
findings.description: 4x href="" social icons, 1x href="#" Brides logo, non-functional See more testimonials button.
findings.recommendation: Wire to real Instagram/TikTok/Brides URLs.

findings.title: No llms.txt, manifest, apple-touch-icon; case-variant URLs 404
findings.description: Minor hygiene items.
findings.recommendation: Backlog after domain launch.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage intro and Talea & Erich case study are strong editorial writing
Brand-voice discipline is clean (no banned words in studio copy)
Founder-led positioning is a real E-E-A-T asset

findings.title: Zero geographic signal
findings.description: No page mentioned Hudson, Hudson Valley, Catskills or New York.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in working tree; deploy.

findings.title: Boilerplate-dominated pages
findings.description: Identical 78-word bio block on 6 of 7 templates; /weddings had 116 words with none unique; /inquire 39 words.
findings.recommendation: Build /weddings into a service page: experience/process, investment, FAQ, venues (Action Plan 2.3).

findings.title: Lorem ipsum and fictional brands live on six URLs
findings.description: /brands/{slug} pages render placeholder brands, stock photos, templated testimonials and PaletteSection default Lorem ipsum.
findings.recommendation: noindex or remove until real projects exist.

findings.title: Gallery location slot shows a year
findings.description: Lindsey & Finn, Natalia & David, Talea & Erich show '2025'; Trisha & Jim is blank.
findings.recommendation: Fill real venue/town; gallery titles will pick it up automatically.

findings.title: Unlinked press claim
findings.description: 'Featured On: Brides' logo links to #.
findings.recommendation: Link the Brides Julia McGuire exclusive.

findings.title: No visible phone/email
findings.description: Only a form; placeholder (555) 123-4567 visible in markup.
findings.recommendation: Publish the chosen contact details in the footer.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles/descriptions on home, weddings, events, brands hub and all six galleries (pre-edit)

findings.title: H1s carried no search intent
findings.description: 'Weddings', 'About', 'Product Launch'; /inquire had no H1.
findings.recommendation: Fixed for home ('Wedding & event floral design studio in Hudson, New York'), weddings ('Hudson Valley Weddings'), brands.

findings.title: Duplicate titles/descriptions
findings.description: /, /about, /inquire and brand slugs shared the default title.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in working tree.

findings.title: 'florist' keyword tradeoff
findings.description: Brand brief bans 'florist'; directory competitors rank on the exact token.
findings.recommendation: Keep out of visible copy; allow in schema @type, GBP category, alt text, and one FAQ question if Molly agrees.

findings.title: No Organization/LocalBusiness entity
findings.description: block_count 0 on every page, raw and rendered.
findings.recommendation: Add Florist (LocalBusiness) graph with areaServed, sameAs, founder.

findings.title: No Service markup
findings.description: Wedding, event and editorial services are unmarked.
findings.recommendation: Three Service nodes referencing the Florist provider.

findings.title: No WebSite, BreadcrumbList, ImageGallery
findings.description: Photography-driven site with no image or breadcrumb markup.
findings.recommendation: Add per findings/schema.md.

findings.title: No Person for Molly
findings.description: Founder is unmarked.
findings.recommendation: Person node linked as founder.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Desktop Lighthouse 100 on all four pages

findings.title: Homepage mobile LCP 4.4s (Poor)
findings.description: Lab, Lighthouse 13.4.1. /weddings 3.0s, /galleries/talea-erich 3.8s, /brands 2.4s.
findings.recommendation: Eager-load first gallery photo; fetchpriority=high on hero LCP image.

findings.title: Oversized image variants
findings.description: whimsy-about-pic.webp sizes=100vw at 364-546px render; wf-logo.webp 256x413 for 59-80px; brand02.webp ~22KB headroom.
findings.recommendation: Fix sizes attributes and source dimensions.

findings.title: /brands TTFB 1.0s
findings.description: Other pages 0.2-0.4s.
findings.recommendation: Check for cold serverless path or caching gap.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Fully SSR; AI crawlers can read all content without JS

findings.title: No citable entity facts
findings.description: No location, service area, founder facts or structured data for answer engines to quote.
findings.recommendation: Working-tree copy adds who/where/for-whom; add schema; add llms.txt after domain launch.

findings.title: No off-site corroboration pointing at this host
findings.description: Dead social links; press unlinked; directories point at NJ.
findings.recommendation: Fix links; update directories to Hudson NY; link Brides.

findings.title: Placeholder and generic alts
findings.description: Follow-us grid repeats brand03.webp x5 with alt 'Brand 03'; gallery alts are 'X gallery image N'.
findings.recommendation: Descriptive alts naming flower, setting, venue/region; real Instagram imagery in Follow-us.

categories.name: Local SEO (unweighted)
what_works: Real, well-reviewed identity exists: WeddingWire 5.0 from 9 reviews

findings.title: NAP conflict Hoboken/Jersey City NJ vs Hudson NY
findings.description: The Knot and WeddingWire list Hoboken NJ; whimsyflower.love says Jersey City; phone 551-264-4181; 'from $3,000' vs brief's $8k minimum.
findings.recommendation: Move GBP/Knot/WeddingWire/socials to Hudson NY; 301 old site; reconcile price.

findings.title: No Google Business Profile found for Hudson NY
findings.description: Not found in search; verify in GBP Manager.
findings.recommendation: Claim as service-area business, category Florist.

findings.title: Name collision with Whimsy Flowers (Kerhonkson NY)
findings.description: Different business already ranking in the target market.
findings.recommendation: Consistent 'Whimsy Flower · Hudson, NY' + sameAs everywhere.

findings.title: No outbound co-citation links
findings.description: Photographers credited but never linked.
findings.recommendation: Link credits; request reciprocal vendor credits.

categories.name: Search Experience / SXO (unweighted)
what_works: /brands has a real 5-step process section to port

findings.title: /weddings is an index page where a service page ranks
findings.description: ~46% of ranking pages are studio service pages with process, minimums, service area, FAQ; benchmark competitor discloses $10k/$7k minimums and an 80-mile radius.
findings.recommendation: Action Plan 2.3.

findings.title: Inquiry friction
findings.description: Form requires date and budget with no disclosed minimum and no phone/email anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Publish Investment section and contact details.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Go live on whimsyflower.com; redirect vercel.app; metadataBase + canonical; verify GSC
Commit and deploy the location copy changes in the working tree
Add robots.ts and sitemap.ts; submit sitemap
noindex or remove the six placeholder brand project pages
Resolve NAP: claim GBP for Hudson NY, update Knot/WeddingWire/socials, 301 whimsyflower.love, reconcile price, publish phone/email
Fix dead social/Brides/testimonial links

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add Florist/LocalBusiness + WebSite + Person + Service + BreadcrumbList + ImageGallery JSON-LD
Add Open Graph / Twitter cards
Build /weddings into a service page: Experience, Investment, FAQ (content only), venues, linked photographers
Mobile Inquire CTA; eager first gallery image; fetchpriority on hero; fix sizes and logo dimensions
Footer link to /brands; internal links from home to weddings
Fill real gallery venues/towns; feature NY-area weddings first
Security headers

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Journal: investment/cost, seasonal garden-style flowers, flower bar guide, workshop guide
Two /weddings spokes: elopements & micro-weddings; ceremony installations
Citations: Zola, Style Me Pretty, Hudson Valley Weddings; photographer/venue co-citations; link Brides
Reviews to the new GBP; replace dead testimonials button with review links
Entity disambiguation from Whimsy Flowers (Kerhonkson)

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Drift baseline after deploy; compare after each release
Configure Google API key + GSC OAuth for field data
Monthly GSC location-query and GBP tracking; quarterly gallery additions
